cafe.first.title: 美香’s café
cafe.first.setting: On your second morning in Tokyo, you step into a quiet café near your new apartment. The owner smiles.

opening.speaker: mika
opening.text: おはようございます！ 初（はじ）めてですか？

cafe.return.title: Back at the café
cafe.return.setting: You stop by the café again. Let 美香 recall what you actually told her.

opening.speaker: mika
opening.text: こんにちは。今日は何（なに）にしますか？

weekend.title: Making Saturday plans
weekend.setting: A regular at the café is choosing a film for Saturday. Your answer determines whether the plan goes ahead.

opening.speaker: yui
opening.text: 土曜日（どようび）、一緒（いっしょ）に映画（えいが）を見ませんか？

station.title: A change of trains
station.setting: Your train has already left. Ask the station attendant for another route.

opening.speaker: kei
opening.text: 次（つぎ）の電車（でんしゃ）にしますか？

dinner.title: Catching up over dinner
dinner.setting: An old friend asks about your trip. Follow a detail, joke or misunderstanding across several turns.

opening.speaker: yui
opening.text: 旅行（りょこう）、どうだった？

film.title: Talking after a show
film.setting: Discuss a scene you chose, explain a reaction, and let the conversation follow your interests.

opening.speaker: yui
opening.text: あの場面（ばめん）、どう思（おも）った？
